purpose: Teach: 南西/貧弱/粘着/一滴/日照/辺境/罪人/首尾

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、南西諸島の地域医療を医療チームで担当します
lines.en: Ren, we'll be handling regional healthcare in the Southwest Islands as a medical team.
lines.style: Clear, professional opening. Steady voice that conveys responsibility without heaviness. Direct eye contact. Measured pace—this is important information being delivered with care.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、貧弱な栄養状態の患者様を医療チームで支援します
lines.en: Ren, we'll be supporting patients with nutritional deficiencies as a medical team.
lines.style: Same steady professional tone. Slight emphasis on 'supporting'—showing attentiveness to patient needs. No rush. Calm authority.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、術後の粘着包帯の交換を医療チームで管理します
lines.en: Ren, we'll be managing post-operative dressing changes as a medical team.
lines.style: Continuous, methodical delivery. Clinical precision in the voice but not cold. The confidence of someone who has done this many times. Even pacing.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、点滴の一滴ごとの管理を医療チームで徹底します
lines.en: Ren, we'll be monitoring every detail of IV administration as a medical team.
lines.style: Slight intensification—'every detail' lands with quiet emphasis. Still calm, but the exactingness of this responsibility comes through. No room for shortcuts in the tone.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、日照不足のビタミンD欠乏症を医療チームで対応します
lines.en: Ren, we'll be addressing vitamin D deficiency from lack of sunlight as a medical team.
lines.style: Back to the even, informative pace. Clinical but warm—this is a real problem affecting real patients. Professional distance maintained.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、辺境地区の往診を医療チームでおこないます
lines.en: Ren, we'll be conducting house calls in remote areas as a medical team.
lines.style: Slight shift: acknowledging the difficulty and commitment this requires. Voice carries a note of resolve. Still measured, but with a hint of the effort being asked.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、罪人の方々への医療提供を医療チームで配慮します
lines.en: Ren, we'll be providing medical care to incarcerated individuals as a medical team.
lines.style: Brief pause before this line. Delivered with steady conviction—no judgment in the voice, only professionalism. The weight of the responsibility is present but not emphasized.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、診療記録の首尾、つまり首尾一貫性を医療チームで保ちます
lines.en: Ren, we'll be maintaining consistency in medical records as a medical team.
lines.style: Final statement—slightly softer landing than the others. Small exhale at the end. The accumulated assignments settle. Calm, closing note of unity and collective purpose.
